dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale greyish-white edges on the primary and secondary feathers against dark grey feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse transition where the solid dark-grey crown meets the high-contrast scalloped texture of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: A single blue-grey artificial identification band is visible on the left tarsus.
